propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, unlike other store git paths which use gitutil.run_git_write and self-heal transient object-DB read failures
Three CI test runs fail identically with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' when bundling a merge commit, caused by the commit object becoming unreadable at bundle time
The 'bad object' signature indicates a missing or unreadable git object, proven by experiment to differ from unborn HEAD ('ambiguous argument') and corrupt objects ('error:' lines)
s3_doctor._git must route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory git-op lock, index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry used by all other store write paths
The transient-marker family in gitutil must be extended to include the proven 'bad object' signature so the observed fault self-heals on retry
S3DoctorConflict error hints must distinguish object-DB read failures from heads conflicts, since the current hint ('run rebar fsck-recover') misdescribes a transient bundle failure
